title: Xfinity WiFi Gateway - Home WiFi Modem and Router
description: Get the Xfinity WiFi Gateway - Xfinity's internet modem + WiFi router in one that is designed to deliver enhanced coverage and the benefits of our best WiFi experience

headings.text: Part modem. Part router. All rock-solid connection.
Xfinity WiFi Gateway. The connectivity hub for your home.
A zero-hassle setup to faster WiFi
Manage your home WiFi experience with the Xfinity app
Keep a smooth connection — no matter who’s online
Serious security for the seriously online
Xfinity Pro. Our most elevated WiFi experience.

Connect with unlimited 4G LTE cellular data during an unexpected network outage with the Pro WiFi Extender. You can also purchase a Battery Backup for a $60 one-time charge to stay online for up to 4 hours if the power goes out.
Get seamless, consistent coverage throughout the house with WiFi Extenders. Xfinity Pro includes up to 2 WiFi Extenders if recommended for your home.

body: Keep a smooth connection — no matter who’s online

• Connect computers, printers, and other devices, both wirelessly and with cables • Secure Xfinity WiFi hotspot for guests (no password needed) • Gateway/network management tool for advanced users (http://10.0.0.1) • Battery backup capability (Xfinity Voice only) • Connect cordless phones and handsets (CAT-iq 2.0*) • Telephone ports: 2
• Maximum data throughput: 2.5Gbps • Ethernet ports: Single 2.5Gbps, Three 1Gbps • DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem • Backwards compatible with non-WiFi 6E, WiFi 6, and WiFi 5-enabled devices or clients
• Compatible with Xumo Stream Box from Xfinity
